notes.title: Version 0.2.2.2 Turbo Mode & QoL

Version 0.2.2.2 Turbo Mode & QoL



Updates:

Introducing Turbo Mode — our new speedrun-inspired game mode! Locked to save slot 4, Turbo Mode cranks the base game speed up by 10x, offering a fast-paced way to play. Please note: Steam achievements and the time bank are disabled in this mode for a pure speedrun experience.

How to Access turbo mode? After Pressing play on the save slot ui scroll down and select Turbo Mode this is save slot 4.

Please note there are no awards that follow over from Turbo Mode into your main saves this is a design choice.

Added a new hover effect for interactables: objects now highlight with an outline and slightly enlarge to help players easily identify them. This applies to Mining nodes, Woodcutting trees, Tracking targets, NPCs (Shopkeepers & Charter NPCs), Imbuing Altars, Thieving Chests & Stalls, and Foraging Chests.

Added a Magnifying glass to mini to Enable Interactable Highlights on hover, you can also hold alt to enable highlights.

Added New Cursor System: Hover cursor now changes when interacting with Mining, Woodcutting, Foraging, and Fishing nodes.

Added Auto-Switching Combat Styles: Combat style now changes automatically based on equipped weapon (configurable, defaults: Melee = Attack, Ranged = Ranged, Magic = Magic). Preferences are saved.

Improved pathfinding for all Bloobathons.

Added New Achievements for Turbo Mode, Please note these are only available in Turbo Mode.

notes.title: 🎉 1 Year Anniversary Update for Bloobs Adventure Idle Steam! 🎉
notes.notes:
🎉 1 Year Anniversary Update for Bloobs Adventure Idle Steam! 🎉

It’s hard to believe, but Bloobs Adventure Idle Steam is officially one year in the making! When I started this journey, I had no previous experience with game development. What began as a passion project filled with prototypes and learning curves has grown into something I’m incredibly proud to share with all of you.

The Beginning: A year ago, I was just getting my feet wet in the world of game development. There were countless hours spent figuring out the basics, building prototypes, and learning what worked (and what definitely didn’t!). But with each mistake, I learned valuable lessons that shaped Bloobs Adventure into what it is today.

What’s Been Accomplished: In this past year, I’ve implemented so many exciting systems that have made Bloobs Adventure more than just an idle game. Here are some of the highlights:

Challenges & Learning: This year hasn’t been without its challenges. From building 22 unique skills to creating my own inventory, bank, equipment, and customization systems, every step has been a learning experience. Implementing features like MiniMap click-to-move, Facepunch Steamworks integration, and Steam Achievements has definitely kept me on my toes. Debugging issues like the minimap click functionality has been a rollercoaster ride, but each challenge has pushed me to grow as a developer. I’m grateful for everything I’ve learned along the way.

Looking Forward: What’s next for Bloobs Adventure? I’ve got big plans! You can expect more content, Content to 100 and beyond, and even more customization options to make your Bloobs experience truly your own.

Thank you to everyone who’s supported me this past year—whether you’ve watched a devlog, played the game, or shared your feedback. This journey wouldn’t be possible without you, and I can’t wait to see where the next year takes us!

Here’s to another year of Bloobs Adventure and many more updates to come!
